messages: It seems #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.

After I told #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, that I want to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He told me tailoring requires one to have the right balance of skill and knowledge and asked me to defeat monsters near #m10002000# and collect #b#t4000011#s#k.
I passed the test given by #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#. Does this mean I can now become a proper tailor of Maple World?
name: Francois in Need of an Apprentice
